title: LoopSkill: Evidence-Bound Lifecycle Control and the Safety-Liveness Tradeoff in Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.18573v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents can edit repositories and announce completion, but conversational claims do not prove that artifacts, dispatches, state versions, and authority still agree. LoopSkill is an evidence-bound lifecycle control plane with a schema-validated sole writer, durable outbox routing, artifact-bound reports, recovery, independent review, and heartbeat-gated finalization. We evaluate a locally frozen v3.3.12 integration under a common 1,800-second budget on a selected subset of SWE-bench Lite. The original 140-cell plan was administratively truncated after interim outcomes were visible, so the 60-cell analysis is exploratory and nonconfirmatory. Of 58 scored cells, blind artifact success was 7/19 for LoopSkill, 11/19 for implementation plus independent review, and 14/20 for an ordinary coding agent; two cells were apparatus null. Across 18 complete LoopSkill-versus-review pairs, the descriptive risk difference was -0.222 with exact McNem

translated_title: LoopSkill：编码智能体中的证据约束生命周期控制与安全性-活性权衡
translated_abstract: 编码智能体可以编辑代码仓库并宣称任务已完成，但对话中的声明并不能证明工件、调度分发、状态版本与权限仍然保持一致。LoopSkill 是一个证据约束的生命周期控制平面，包含经模式验证的唯一写入者、持久化发件箱路由、工件绑定的报告、恢复机制、独立评审以及由心跳门控的最终定稿。我们在统一的 1,800 秒预算下，于 SWE-bench Lite 的一个选定子集上评估了本地冻结的 v3.3.12 集成。原始的 140 个单元格实验计划在中期结果可见后因管理决策被截断，因此 60 个单元格的分析属于探索性、非确证性研究。在 58 个计分单元格中，盲评工件成功率为：LoopSkill 7/19，“实现+独立评审”方案 11/19，普通编码智能体 14/20；另有 2 个单元格因实验装置问题记为无效。在 18 个完整的 LoopSkill 与评审对照配对中，描述性风险差异为 -0.222，精确 McNemar（检验结果）……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: LoopSkill 提出了一个面向编码智能体的证据约束生命周期控制平面（集成唯一写入者、持久化发件箱、工件绑定报告、独立评审与心跳门控终局等机制），并在 SWE-bench Lite 上的探索性实验中揭示了“安全性-活性”权衡——更严格的证据绑定控制反而降低了任务完成成功率。
en_tdlr: LoopSkill proposes an evidence-bound lifecycle control plane for coding agents (with a schema-validated sole writer, durable outbox routing, artifact-bound reports, independent review, and heartbeat-gated finalization), and its exploratory SWE-bench Lite evaluation reveals a safety-liveness tradeoff whereby stricter evidence-bound control reduces task completion success rates.
